answer: A concrete defense is a refundable identity stake: every account must lock tokens equal to one epoch's full reward, slashed whenever two identities mirror identical answering behavior. A public signal ledger lets honest peers flag coordinated clusters, while a small per-identity pigment fee dyes each identity uniquely on-chain. Spinning up N fake accounts then costs N stakes plus N fees with no discount, so the attacker pays the honest price N times over.
